lastCommit.message:
[ota-hal] OTA-1723 — the kitchen opens

Your question, typed into the game itself where it counts: *"Why is food and
health crafting so rare now?"*

⚠⚠⚠ WHAT THE MEASUREMENT SAID BEFORE ANYTHING WAS WRITTEN. The game has
TWENTY-SIX food items and THREE recipes. All three are stews. All three need a
filled Water Bottle — and a filled Water Bottle never drops. What drops is the
EMPTY, at weight 4 of 270 (1.5%), which you then carry to a water source and fill
on a per-room cooldown. So the entire cooked-food economy hung off the rarest
object in the forage pool, through a two-step chain, and the filled bottle is
ALSO the drink you heal with — cooking was competing with survival for the same
item.

⚠⚠ AND THE PANTRY WAS ALREADY FULL. Wild Oats, Wild Lettuce, Rhubarb Stalk,
Orange Sporecap, Blueberries, Raspberries, Speckled Egg — every one of them drops
from the ground, and not one was named by a recipe. Your own log has you scraping
silt and pulling up Raspberries and a Speckled Egg while the cookbook asks you
for onions. The things you find and the things the recipes want were two
different lists.

FIVE DISHES, built on what the ground actually gives:

  · Berry Mash — blueberries + raspberries. No fire, no water.
  · Green Fold — wild lettuce + carrot + rhubarb. No fire, no water.
  · Oat Cake — wild oats ×2 + firewood.
  · Forager's Skillet — speckled egg + wild onion + firewood.
  · Sporecap Skewer — orange sporecap + red cap + firewood.

⚠ NONE OF THEM NEEDS THE BOTTLE, and that is the actual unblock. Adding five more
recipes that all wanted water would have been five more things you cannot cook.
Two need no fire either, so they can be made on any tile, on any day, with what
is in your pack.

⚠⚠ HEARTY STEW IS UNLOCKED. It was the only Rare-result food, so it was the only
dish gated behind a random recipe note — you could hold every ingredient and be
told nothing, with no way to learn that cooking was even the reason. Fixed as a
RULE: food is never discovery-locked, which is the same carve-out materials have
had since OTA-731 ("crafting intermediates — never lock them behind discovery,
otherwise the refine chain soft-blocks everything downstream"). Cooking is a
survival basic on exactly that argument. Done as a rule rather than by dropping
Hearty Stew to Uncommon, because its rarity is what the stew is WORTH and
changing that to dodge a gate nerfs the dish to fix the door.

⚠ THE BOTTLE: 4 → 12 in BOTH tables, 1.5% → 4.3% of a forage. Both, because your
log shows "investigate the ground" as your most-used action by a wide margin and
that routes to the DIG pool — a bottle made common only in the forage table would
have been common everywhere except where you play. The three original stews still
ask for water; the supply moved, not the recipes.

⚠ ONE ASSERTION OF MINE WAS TOO STRONG and the suite caught it. I claimed every
non-food Rare stays discovery-locked. One does not: Mudstone, a Rare-rarity
MATERIAL, unlocked by that same OTA-731 carve-out. The test now states the
measured truth — exactly two unlocked rares, Hearty Stew and Mudstone — rather
than a tidier sentence that was false.

⚠ ON "HEALTH CRAFTING": your fresh log shows it working — Field Dressing, Trauma
Kit, Corruption Tonic and three Mudstones all crafted in one sitting. So that
half of your question was supply, not a blocked path, and the bottle change lifts
it too.
